legacy_training_note: The seven closed-cycle v2-v3 development sources and their already-versioned labels are promoted to v4 training only; none can regain validation/final status.

rules.final_holdout: POS_8091164 and POS_8239540 labels may be stored and hashed, but their images/labels cannot be consumed by model training, prompt/threshold selection, pseudo-label selection, model comparison or error-driven tuning before a separately committed champion freeze.
rules.label_changes: Any correction to validation/final labels after v4 model inference begins invalidates their role for clean final evidence unless a new source is selected before seeing model output.
rules.claim_boundary: These labels support portfolio experiments only. No material, condition, corrosion, defect, failure or safety-risk claim is encoded.
